traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: The shark has advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its hit points.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.text: The shark can breathe only underwater.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: The plesiosaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.text: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

traits.name: Dive Attack
traits.text: If the quetzalcoatlus is flying and dives at least 30 feet toward a target and then hits with a bite attack, the attack deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage to the target.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.text: The quetzalcoatlus doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Charge
traits.text: If the rhinoceros moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.text: The tiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.text: If the tiger moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny snake. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

attacks.name: Bites
attacks.rider: or 3 (1d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

attacks.name: Tail
attacks.rider: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

attacks.name: Claw
attacks.rider: and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). The scorpion has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

attacks.name: Sting
attacks.rider: and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The scorpion makes three attacks: two with its claws and one with its sting.

traits.name: Echolocation
traits.text: The whale can't use its blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: The whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

traits.name: Keen Hearing
traits.text: The whale has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.text: If the elephant moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the elephant can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

traits.name: Air Form
traits.text: The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 4-6)
actions.text:
Each creature in the elemental's space must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage and is flung up 20 feet away from the elemental in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes an object, such as a wall or floor, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.
If the saving throw is successful, the target takes half the bludgeoning damage and isn't flung away or knocked prone.

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.rider: and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.text: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.text: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 feet.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.text: For every 5 feet the elemental moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

attacks.name: Touch
attacks.rider: If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it ignites. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The elemental makes two touch attacks.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: The crocodile can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

traits.text: As a bonus action, the swarm can shed dim light from its brains in a 5-foot radius, increase the illumination to bright light in a 5 to 20-foot radius (and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius), or extinguish the light.

traits.name: Water Form
traits.text: The elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Freeze
traits.text: If the elemental takes cold damage, it partially freezes; its speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The elemental makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Whelm (Recharge 4-6)
actions.text:
Each creature in the elemental's space must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a target takes 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If it is Large or smaller, it is also grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. If the saving throw is successful, the target is pushed out of the elemental's space.
The elemental can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at one time. At the start of each of the elemental's turns, each target grappled by it takes 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A creature within 5 feet of the elemental can pull a creature or object out of it by taking an action to make a DC 14 Strength check and succeeding.

traits.name: Trampling Charge
traits.text: If the mammoth moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the mammoth can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.
